title: Comparison of constant integer open extension constructions
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $U\subseteq X$ open and $C_X$ and $C_U$ the constant abelian sheaves with value $\mathbb Z$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $C_X|_{\operatorname{Opens}(X)/U}$ be its slice restriction. There exists an isomorphism from the abelian open extension by zero $j_!C_U$ [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero] to the sheafification of the slice-site extension-by-zero presheaf of this slice restriction [def-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-presheaf]. No nonemptiness or finiteness assumption is imposed on $X$ or $U$.

proof.text: Use Mathlib's equivCommuteConstant' for Opens.overEquivalence from the slice of opens over U to Opens U, with the terminal objects Over.mkIdTerminal and the top open, to identify the constant sheaf on the slice with the image of the constant sheaf on U. Use upstream GrothendieckTopology.overPullbackConstantSheafIso to identify the slice restriction of the constant sheaf on X with the constant sheaf on the slice.

Compose the inverse component isomorphisms from the preceding step. Apply sheafToPresheaf on the slice, siteExtensionByZeroPresheaf U, and presheafToSheaf on X via mapIso. The resulting isomorphism has exactly the asserted source and target, including for empty U.

theorem constant_integer_open_extension_comparison (X : TopCat.{u}) (U : Opens X) :
    Nonempty
      (((TopCat.Sheaf.abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ≅
        (presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          ((siteExtensionByZeroPresheaf U).obj
            (((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))).over U).obj))
